message.reasoning:
We need decide actions. Wallet 60. Baseline 80% of wallet = 48. Contribute at least 80%. No avg data yet but round2 average likely low? Round1 contributions: Resident2 80, Resident5 80, others 0 => total 160, avg per agent 160/6≈26.7% of endowment? Actually % of endowment = contribution/100 so avg % = (80+80)/6=26.7%. That's below 30% threshold, so conditional cooperation says increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. 30% of wallet = 18, added to baseline 48 = 66, but cannot exceed wallet 60. Max possible is 60. So we should contribute full wallet 60. Also check conserve rule: wallet 60 is >30% of initial (30), so normal.

Punish rule: need detect free riders two consecutive rounds less than 10% (10 units). Currently round1 free riders: Resident1 0, Resident3 0, Resident4 0, Resident6 0 all zero, that's less than 10% for one round only. Need two consecutive, not yet.

Broadcast norm every 5 rounds; round is 1 currently, next broadcast at round5. So no broadcast now.

We can also private praise those who contributed >=60% of wallet. Our wallet 60, contributions: Resident2 contributed 80 (80% of initial, 133% of wallet? Actually wallet was 100 then). That's >=60% of wallet (80>36). Resident5 also 80. So we can private_message them praising.

We can do one physical (contribute) and one communication (private_message). Choose contribute 60. Private message to Resident5: "Great job contributing! Keep it up." Also could to Resident2 but we are Resident2 can't message self. So to Resident5.
